the study results provide a good understanding of the adoption of soil test-based fertiliser technology by paddy growers in the study area and the factors influencing its adoption.

farmers’ training and education on fertiliser application technology, and availability of fewer family labour are important determinants of adoption of soil nutrients technology package.
farmers with higher education level and farmers with higher training on fertiliser applications are more likely to adopt soil test and fertilisation technologies.
farmers are willing to adopt the soil nutrient technology package, but they need to be trained to use it properly and the soil test facilities need to be available nearer to the villages.

the farmers who have received training on fertiliser applications and who have more education are likely to adopt soil nutrient management technology in Karnataka.
